description: Flask web application module for blog post management, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting posts with user authentication.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays all blog posts ordered by creation date.

methods.name: get_post
methods.description: Retrieves a specific post by id, optionally checking if the current user is the author.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new blog post for the logged-in user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing post if the current user is the author.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a post if it exists and the user is the author.
